prompt:
The section sections/promo-strip.liquid renders a one-line promotional message. Add support for a color tone modifier class. Inputs (all under section.settings): - section.settings.message: string or null. - section.settings.tone: string or null. Required output: - When message is null, output nothing at all. This is the existing behavior; keep it. - Otherwise output exactly `

MESSAGE

`, with no whitespace between elements. - MESSAGE is the message HTML-escaped with the core `escape` filter. This is unchanged from the current file. - TONE is determined by section.settings.tone: - If tone is exactly "sale", TONE is "sale". - If tone is exactly "warning", TONE is "warning". - In every other case, TONE is "info". This includes "info", null, the empty string, any other value, and different capitalization such as "Sale". The comparison is case-sensitive and does not trim. - The tone value must never be echoed raw into the HTML. - Keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/promo-strip.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
